Advanced ATC

स्वचालित निर्भर निगरानी प्रसारण (इन)

A surveillance function enabling an aircraft to receive and display ADS-B broadcasts from other aircraft, increasing situational awareness (ICAO Annex 10, FAA AIM).

Quick answer: A surveillance function enabling an aircraft to receive and display ADS-B broadcasts from other aircraft, increasing situational awareness (ICAO Annex 10, FAA AIM).

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ICAO Doc 9432, FAA PCG and published by Protermify Aviation as a static aviation reference page.

Definition

A surveillance function enabling an aircraft to receive and display ADS-B broadcasts from other aircraft, increasing situational awareness (ICAO Annex 10, FAA AIM).

Operational example

ADS-B In displays nearby traffic information, enhancing situational awareness and collision avoidance.
